# DeepThought

> DeepThought is an AI-powered paid media platform for small and medium businesses. Its AI
> recommends the channels, budget and audiences, drafts the ads (copy, images and video),
> and reports results in plain English — across 22 ad products from search and social to
> streaming TV — for about half the cost of a comparable agency retainer.

Serves the United States, from single-location businesses to multi-location operators of
a few dozen sites. Month-to-month, no long-term contract. Pricing is per product; the
figure for a given business comes from a short call.

DeepThought
1531 Grove Arbor Ct, Dacula, GA 30019
770-299-9583
Support@deepthought.marketing

## Key facts

- Pricing: about half a comparable agency retainer, month to month
- Ad products: 22, in 8 groups
- Channel types: search, social, video and streaming TV, display, audio, email and direct
  mail, local (Yelp), retail media (Amazon)
- AI: recommends channels, budgets and audiences; drafts ad copy, images and video;
  produces plain-English reporting
- Launch timing: as soon as possible once accounts are set up
- Post-launch: continuous optimization, budget reallocation, creative rewrites, reporting
- Contract: month to month, cancel any time
- Coverage: nationwide (US), with per-county market pages for all 3,141 US counties
- Typical customers: home services, retail, healthcare, dental, auto, fitness, real estate

## Common questions

**How fast can a campaign launch?** As soon as possible. Once accounts are set up, the AI
recommends the channels, budget and audiences and drafts the ads, so there is no weeks-long
production queue.

**Who is it for?** Small and medium businesses running their own paid media — services,
retail, healthcare, home services — from one location to a few dozen.

**Does it manage campaigns after launch?** Yes. Optimization, budget reallocation, creative
refreshes, and reporting continue for the life of the campaign. The operator approves
direction; the platform does the work.

**Is there a contract?** No. Month to month, cancel any time.

**Is it an agency?** No. It is a platform that performs the execution work an agency would,
without the retainer or the briefing cycle. A human expert is available on request.
